data.text:
Shiv Parsan Yadav vs The State Of Bihar on 27 March, 2024 
Author: Prabhat Kumar Singh
Bench: Prabhat Kumar Singh
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Patna
 Criminal Miscellaneous No.11851 of 2024
 Arising Out of Ps. Case No.-118 Year-2016 Thana- Sathi District- Wes
 ======================================================
 Shiv Parsan Yadav S/o Dhruv Yadav Resident of Village-Basantpur,
 P.S.-Sathi, District-West Champaran.
 ... .
 Versus
 The State of Bihar Bihar
 ... ... Opposite Party/s 
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Dhananjay Kumar
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Ashok Kumar Singh
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Prabhat Kumar Singh
 Oral Order 
3 27-03-2024 Heard the parties and perused the trial court report dated 18.3.2024. 
2. Petitioner seeks regular bail in a case registered under Sections 147, 148, 149, 341, 323,324, 302 and 504 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 27 of the Arms Act. 
3. As per prosecution case, on 08.09.2016 at about 05.15 P.M. when the informant Manan Yadav alongiwth his father Jhapas Yadav and uncle Jhagru Yadav, in course of returning from his field, sat at platform of Chhathghat, 11 accused persons, named in the F.I.R.,including the petitioner and 4-5 unknown having lathi, bhala, farsa and gun in their hands, surrounded them. At that time,
co-accused Dhruv Yadav ordered to kill them. Thereafter, he himself fired through his gun at the father of the informant causing firearm injury on his leg and co- Patna High Court CR. MISC. 
No.11851 of 2024(3) dt.27-03-2024 accused Rajendra Yadav fired from his gun at the uncle of the informant causing firearm injury on his thigh, whereas co- accused Garjan Yadav, Ramdatt Yadav and petitioner (Shiv Parsan Yadav) having lathi in their hands and Ram Parsan Yadav, Guddu Yadav, Jawahar Yadav, Bachchu Yadav, Shambhu Yadav and others having lathi and bhala in their hands brutally assaulted father and uncle of the informant and caused injury to them. Both of them rushed to the hospital but they died in course of treatment. 
Shiv Parsan Yadav vs The State Of Bihar on 27 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161828650/
1 4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the specific allegation of causing firearm injury to the uncle and father of the informant is against co-accused Dhruv Yadav and Rajendra Yadav. So far petitioner is concerned, there is general and omnibus allegation of assault by means of lathi, farsa and no specific overt act has been alleged against him. He further submits that in post-mortem report of the dead body of both the deceased, only one lacerated injury caused by hard and blunt substance was found on the person of father of the informant, whereas two lacerated injuries caused by hard and blunt substance were found on the person of uncle of the informant. It is also submitted that the petitioner was not present at the time of the occurrence rather he was staying in Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.11851 of 2024(3) dt.27-03-2024 other State for earning livelihood. He has been implicated in this case because one of the co-accused Bachchu Yadav had earlier lodged Sathi P.S.
Case No.33 of 2010 under Sections 341, 323, 324, 379 and 504/34 of the Indian penal Code against uncle of the informant and his other family members. Petitioner claims clean antecedent. Petitioner is in custody since 1.3.2019. Several co-accused, with similar allegation, have already been allowed bail by different co-ordinate bench of this Court vide orders passed in Cr.Mis.No. 4832/2017 and 1364/2017. 
5. Considering the aforesaid facts of the case, prayer for bail of the petitioner is allowed. Let the petitioner, mentioned above, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Additional Sessions Judge II cum Special Judge Food Safety and Std Act, 2006, Bettiah, West Champaran in Sessions Trial No.
613 of 2019, CIS No.463 of 2019, Bettiah, West Champaran in connection with Sathi P.S. Case No.118 of 2016. 
 (Prabhat Kumar Singh, J)
